channel.title: Ali Alinaghi — Articles
channel.description: Practical guides on resource estimation, geostatistics, kriging, variograms, cut-off grade, the JORC Code, QA/QC and the stages of mineral exploration.

item.title: What is kriging? A practical guide for resource estimation
item.description: Ordinary, simple and indicator kriging explained: the kriging system, weights and screening, kriging variance, kriging neighbourhood analysis (KNA), smoothing and common mistakes in resource estimation.

item.title: The variogram explained: calculation, modelling and interpretation
item.description: The variogram explained: definition and formula, nugget, sill and range, experimental variogram calculation, spherical, exponential and Gaussian models, anisotropy, and use in drill spacing and resource estimation.

item.title: Cut-off grade: what it is and how to calculate it
item.description: Cut-off grade explained: break-even and marginal cut-off formulas, worked copper and gold examples, grade–tonnage curves, Lane's theory, cut-off in JORC resource reporting, and a free online calculator.

item.title: Mineral resources vs ore reserves under the JORC Code
item.description: Mineral Resources and Ore Reserves under the JORC Code: Inferred, Indicated and Measured resources, Probable and Proved reserves, Modifying Factors, the Competent Person, and their UNFC equivalents (codes 111, 122, 333) used in Iranian reports.

item.title: QA/QC of exploration data
item.description: A practical guide to QA/QC of exploration data: quality assurance versus quality control, certified reference materials, blanks and duplicates, insertion rates, control charts, acceptance criteria and a pre-estimation checklist.

item.title: Stages of mineral exploration in Iran
item.description: The technical stages of mineral exploration (reconnaissance, prospecting, general and detailed exploration) and the administrative path in Iran: exploration licence, final exploration report, discovery certificate and exploitation licence, with common mistakes.

item.title: Sarcheshmeh porphyry copper deposit: geology and resources
item.description: Geology of the Sarcheshmeh porphyry Cu–Mo deposit, Kerman, Iran: host rocks, geochronology, alteration zones, published resource figures with source and year, and a contained-copper check.

item.title: Miduk porphyry copper deposit: geology and resources
item.description: The Miduk porphyry copper deposit in Shahr-e Babak County, Kerman: two Miocene intrusive phases, Re–Os age, alteration and enrichment zones, and published resource figures with sources.

item.title: Kahang porphyry copper deposit: geology and exploration
item.description: The Kahang porphyry Cu–Mo deposit in Ardestan County, Isfahan: discovery from Landsat imagery, U–Pb and Re–Os ages, alteration zones and the published resource figure.

item.title: Sungun porphyry copper deposit: geology and resources
item.description: The Sungun porphyry copper deposit in Varzaqan County, East Azerbaijan: zircon and Re–Os ages, alteration and skarn, and the December 2024 discovery certificate with a contained-copper check.

item.title: Masjed Daghi porphyry copper–gold deposit: geology and resources
item.description: The Masjed Daghi porphyry Cu–Au deposit in the Aras Free Zone east of Jolfa: contested age, alteration, high-sulphidation epithermal gold veins and published resource figures.

item.title: Dalli porphyry copper–gold deposit: geology and resources
item.description: The Dalli porphyry Cu–Au deposit in Delijan County, Markazi Province: Northern and Southern Hills, the pyrite shell, an Ar–Ar age and published resource figures.

item.title: Gol-e-Gohar iron ore deposit: geology and origin
item.description: The Gol-e-Gohar iron ore deposit in Sirjan County, Kerman: six orebodies in the Sanandaj–Sirjan Zone, the dispute between a magmatic-hydrothermal and a metamorphosed banded-iron-formation origin, and published resource figures.

item.title: Chadormalu magnetite–apatite deposit: geology and age
item.description: The Chadormalu iron ore deposit in Ardakan County, Yazd: a Kiruna-type magnetite–apatite deposit of the Bafq district, apatite U–Pb ages, alteration and the pre-mining reserve.

item.title: Choghart magnetite–apatite deposit: geology and alteration
item.description: The Choghart iron ore deposit in Bafq County, Yazd: an iron oxide–apatite deposit of the Bafq district, alteration stages, thorium and rare-earth mineralisation, and the gaps in the published record.

item.title: Sangan iron skarn district: geology and resources
item.description: The Sangan iron ore district in Khaf County, Razavi Khorasan: Eocene iron skarns, the Sarnowsar intrusion, geochronology, the orebodies and conflicting resource figures.

item.title: Mehdiabad zinc–lead deposit: geology and resources
item.description: The Mehdiabad Zn–Pb–Ba deposit in Mehriz County, Yazd: Lower Cretaceous host rocks, the SEDEX vs carbonate-replacement debate, sulphide and non-sulphide ore, and shifting resource figures.

item.title: Angouran zinc–lead deposit: geology and origin
item.description: The Angouran Zn–Pb deposit in Mahneshan County, Zanjan: marble and schist host, high-grade sulphide and zinc-carbonate ore, four competing views of its origin and converging resource figures.

item.title: Irankuh zinc–lead district: geology and deposit type
item.description: The Irankuh Zn–Pb district south of Isfahan: Aptian carbonate–clastic host rocks, three competing deposit models (MVT, syn-sedimentary, Irish-type), and the Gushfil and Tappehsorkh pits.

item.title: Zarshuran gold deposit: geology and resources
item.description: The Zarshuran gold deposit in Takab County, West Azerbaijan: invisible gold in arsenian pyrite, Miocene ages, arsenic and mercury minerals, and a reconciliation of conflicting resource figures.

item.title: Agh-Darreh gold deposit: geology and mineralisation
item.description: The Agh-Darreh gold deposit in Takab County: a carbonate-hosted epithermal gold deposit with Carlin-type affinities in the Takab geothermal field, its alteration sequence, invisible gold and the published resource.

item.title: Sari Gunay gold deposit: geology and resources
item.description: The Sari Gunay epithermal gold deposit in Qorveh County, Kurdistan: a Miocene volcanic complex, geochronology, quartz–stibnite–realgar veins, heap leaching and published resource figures.

item.title: Muteh gold deposits: geology and age
item.description: The Muteh gold district in Isfahan Province: metamorphic-hosted gold in the Sanandaj–Sirjan Zone, the Eocene age of mineralisation, the orogenic interpretation, alteration and reported production.
